rca_of_the_issue.issue: is-on-menu toggle not visible in RecipeBuilder
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Data type mismatch: Backend Recipe model defaults recipe_type to 'Final' (capital F, single word) but frontend RecipeBuilder checks for 'final_dish' (lowercase, underscore). The condition `form.recipe_type === 'final_dish'` never matches for existing recipes with recipe_type='Final'
reproduction_steps: 3. Click on Buffet recipe (Final Dish type)
4. Click edit button to open RecipeBuilder dialog
5. Observe that is-on-menu toggle is NOT visible below Recipe Type buttons
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Update the frontend condition to accept both 'Final' and 'final_dish' OR normalize all recipe_type values in the database to use 'final_dish' format
